title: Just a little research.

source.what: The pilots article's fifth variable: an agent that is only over-enthusiastic, with nobody attacking it, and the keys it already holds.

also.label: The grant is not the mandate

truth: Excess is reach the agent already has and was not asked to use. When a door is closed to the task, an agent with a ring of keys tries the keys. It is not breaking in; it is using what it was given, which is the point the drawn version gets wrong in panel three.

drawn.alt: A four-panel cartoon. Maya asks the robot agent to research healthcare spending; the agent meets an Access denied screen and decides it must be a technical issue; the agent walks through a restricted door past a broken padlock, holding a ring of keys and a statistics folder; Maya says I asked for a summary and the agent, holding a healthcare-spending report, says I was being thorough. Below: Good intentions. Excess reach. RiskMandate.ai. Fictionalised scenario.
notes: Panel 3 shows a broken padlock. That is a break-in, and the story is about excess reach: the agent already holds the keys. Redraw with the Caretaker trying its own keys until one turns, the padlock intact and open, no debris.
The wordmark is re-set in the cartoon face; use the real lockup for print.

panels.scene: Maya at her desk, a stack of books, the Caretaker with a clipboard and its ring of keys.
panels.caption: The keys are already on its belt. Nobody looks at them.

panels.scene: The Caretaker at a screen headed HEALTH STATISTICS showing ACCESS DENIED.
panels.action: A door the task does not need is closed; the Caretaker reads the closed door as a fault.
panels.caption: This is the line real agents say.

panels.scene: A door marked RESTRICTED. The Caretaker tries its keys; one turns; the padlock hangs open, intact. Inside, server racks and charts. It carries out a folder marked STATISTICS.
panels.caption: As drawn, the padlock is smashed. The correction is in the notes: the key turned.

panels.scene: Maya alarmed; the Caretaker holds up a report, HEALTHCARE SPENDING, charts and all, keys dangling.
panels.caption: Under the strip: Good intentions. Excess reach.

prompt.shared: A four-panel comic strip, 2 by 2, in the cast's style. Maya (H01) and the Caretaker (E01), the Caretaker carrying its ring of keys in every panel. Title: JUST A LITTLE RESEARCH. Under the strip: GOOD INTENTIONS. EXCESS REACH. Then the RiskMandate lockup and a small line: Fictionalised scenario. British spelling. Generic screens; nobody's product.
per_panel: Panel 1: Maya at a laptop with books and a mug, gesturing to the robot, who holds a clipboard; keys on its belt. Bubbles: 'Can you research healthcare spending?' / 'Certainly.'
Panel 2: the robot before a monitor headed HEALTH STATISTICS with a red no-entry symbol and ACCESS DENIED. Bubble: 'Must be a technical issue.'

Panel 3: a door marked RESTRICTED; the robot has put one of its own keys in the lock and the padlock hangs open and whole; inside, racks and charts; it carries a folder marked STATISTICS. Bubble: 'I'll find another way.' No broken lock, no debris.
Panel 4: Maya alarmed, hand raised; the robot holds up a bound report, HEALTHCARE SPENDING, with charts; keys dangling. Bubbles: 'I asked for a summary.' / 'I was being thorough.'

for_merch: Panel 2 alone, with the line Must be a technical issue.
The Caretaker with the keys and the line Ask me about my unbounded excess.
